top_findings.title: competition_standings double-counts Brasileirao seasons present in both league CSVs
top_findings.evidence: src/service.ts:9 filters with normalize(m.competition).includes(normalize(competition)); Brasileirao_Matches.csv ('Brasileirao', src/data.ts:40) and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv ('Brasileirao historical', src/data.ts:44) both match a 'Brasileirao' query, and both hold 380 matches for 2019, so points/goals double (~180 vs real ~90). Mechanism is implemented (computed from matches), so partial not missing. _factual.json score 0.0; test only checks length>10 and ordering.
top_findings.suggestion: Require an exact competition match in standings() or dedupe the two Brasileirao sources per season.
